checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'article-brief'.

checks.description: Each brief sets one target query and one clear intent.
checks.rule: Each article_brief carries a single target_query and one intent; multi-intent briefs are split or focused.

checks.description: Each brief carries target query, intent, outline, internal links, and one CTA.
checks.rule: Every article_brief includes id, target_query, intent, outline, internal_links, and cta.

checks.description: The skill produces a brief, not final article copy.
checks.rule: Body states the article is authored later by copywriter-ar or copywriter-en, not in this skill.

checks.description: Each brief sets exactly one CTA.
checks.rule: Each article_brief has a single cta; no competing actions.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name in the brief.
checks.rule: Brief references only offers and titles traceable to the source brief; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask, never accreditation claims.

checks.description: The brief frames the article empowering, never deficit-framed.
checks.rule: Outline and CTA speak to what the reader can build, not to what they lack, per brand-voice.md.
